findings.title: governance formula gains route and measure
findings.claim: The managed affair becomes a directed dispatch: its course begins at the sky, reaches earth, and then turns upward before its measure is stated.
findings.mechanism: يُدَبِّرُ governs ٱلْأَمْرَ; مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ and إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ assign source and lower endpoint, ثُمَّ introduces the ascent to إِلَيْهِ, and the day clause supplies the scale.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah reads as one coordinated route with a temporal frame, not as three disconnected facts.
findings.containment: The ordinary sense of managing an affair remains intact. “Dispatch” names the relation among the local words, not a literal object or an added agent.

epistemic.reason: The the contact among local words is directly checkable in the focus ayah; no wider context is required for this reading.

findings.reader_payoff: The verse opens with active governance rather than a completed past event.
findings.containment: The local form marks aspect and person, but it does not identify the agent by name; the support's prior-ayah identification is excluded.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees management unfold before the return stage begins.
findings.containment: This is a local sequence claim; it does not decide which entity is the unexpressed subject of يَعْرُجُ.

findings.title: command and affair remain fused

findings.containment: The affair reading stays available. This does not say the word means only a command or identify the content of that command.
